drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 85-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.78, creatinine 0.86-0.91, hemoglobin 14.6-14.7, platelets 193-198, sodium 140, wbc 6.6-6.8; vitals dbp 75-79, heart_rate 69-74, map 90-93, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-17, sbp 118-122, spo2 96-97, temp 36.6-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute kidney injury ruled out.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.91-0.99, hemoglobin 14.6-14.7, platelets 193-200, sodium 140, wbc 6.5-7; vitals dbp 75-79, heart_rate 70-73, map 89-93, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 118-122, spo2 96-97, temp 36.6-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute kidney injury ruled out. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 85-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. Acute kidney injury ruled out. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
